articles.summary: Real people and real pizza, what a combo! Join us in person or virtually for “Observing Golang: OpenTelemetry from Code to Prod”, presented by Roni Dover, CTO and Co-Founder at Digma. GoMN Meetup, September 21, 6pm CDT at SPS Tower We also provide a virtual option, via Zoom, for those uncomfortable attending in-person. Meetup Registration Here!
